ns2:course.label: Open Seminar in German Studies
ns2:course.description: Seminar in literary phenomena (such as movements, genres and forms, relations, themes and types, interdisciplinary studies, women's studies) that go beyond the confines of a particular century. May be repeated in separate semesters to a maximum of 12 hours if topics vary.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated in separate semesters to a maximum of 12 hours if topics vary.
